headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Apply tracking-tight to H1-H3. Use font-semibold or font-medium to avoid overly heavy black weights unless intentional. Inject into global CSS.

body.rules: Use for all standard body copy, labels, and data tables. Maintain high contrast.

colors.archetype_rules: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) + Soft Utility. Primary CTA should be the vibrant orange. Everything else should rely on high contrast monochrome hierarchy. Do not use teal green/blue.

layouts.dashboard_shell: Use a collapsible left sidebar layout (not top bar). Sidebar should have a very subtle border-r (border-zinc-200) and white background. The main content area should have bg-zinc-50 to provide contrast against white content cards.
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 or gap-8 for grid layouts. This prevents cognitive overload.
layouts.cards: White background, rounded-xl or rounded-2xl, border border-zinc-200, shadow-sm. Use 'Tactile Neumorphism': mix soft shadows with crisp 1px inner borders for structure.
layouts.playlist_editor: Two-pane layout (Bento inspired). Left: The playlist timeline (draggable items). Right: The media library picker. Prioritize desktop/tablet spacing.
layouts.screen_preview: Simulate a TV screen with a 16:9 aspect ratio container. Use a thick black border (bg-black p-2 rounded-lg) to mimic a physical TV bezel, with a very subtle inner shadow. Place playback controls floating below.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or rounded-lg with clear hover states (slight lift -translate-y-0.5 and color shift). Primary buttons should be solid vibrant orange. Secondary buttons should be outline or subtle gray.
components.tables: High contrast, screen-reader optimized. Use Shadcn UI Table. Striped rows on hover (hover:bg-zinc-100/50).
components.drag_drop: Use @hello-pangea/dnd for reordering playlists. Show a drag handle icon (six dots from lucide-react) on draggable items.
components.toast: Use sonner for success/error notifications. Positioned at top-right.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Use for 'Pair Device' (6-digit code entry) and 'Add Screen'.

visual_enhancers.empty_states: Never show a blank screen. If a playlist is empty or no screens are added, show a friendly illustration/icon with a clear 'Add your first X' CTA. Use empty states to educate non-technical users.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on media thumbnails should show a subtle zoom-in effect (scale-105) with a play icon overlay for videos.
visual_enhancers.status_indicators: Use pulsating dots (green for online, gray for offline) to indicate screen connectivity status. This is critical for restaurant owners to quickly verify displays.

restaurant_location.description: Modern restaurant interior for location thumbnails

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement design using React JS (not TS).
Install and use @hello-pangea/dnd for drag-and-drop playlist reordering.
Use lucide-react for all icons. Avoid emojis.
Ensure 'Outfit' font is loaded in index.css and applied to h1-h6 tags. Use Inter for body.
When building the dashboard shell, use a left sidebar (w-64) that is collapsible. Implement proper responsive behavior (hamburger on mobile, permanent sidebar on desktop).
Use Shadcn UI (Card, Button, Input, Table, Dialog, Sonner, Tabs). Customize the Card component to have border-zinc-200 and shadow-sm.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
Maintain the hierarchy: Admin -> Restaurant Account -> Location -> Screens -> Playlists -> Media.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or rounded-lg with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
